provenanceNote: The production replies are in production's agent_steps and were never copied into the repository, so this is a reconstruction. Quoted from the production notes: the flagged words YouGov's, UK's, UK-focused, AER and More UK. The sentences follow ce2ceef's own test sentences; the bank in the third note is fictional (the real one in ce2ceef's test is left out here). notes.title: Budgeting is on people's minds
notes.text: YouGov's financial outlook looks at how adults plan their spending, and budgeting comes up again and again.

notes.title: Easy-access savers want simple rates
notes.text: Among UK savers, simple easy-access accounts paying a clear AER on an ISA are what people look for. It fills a gap the UK-focused apps miss.

notes.title: A bank added a budgeting assistant
notes.text: Harbourline Bank launched the UK's first budgeting assistant inside its current account app.

notes.title: New year, new budget
notes.text: More UK adults look for budgeting help in January than in any other month.
